name: domarinn
description: LLM eval harness. Connects to a domarinn server's MCP endpoint for read-only access to eval history, and ships skills for authoring, running, and triaging eval suites with the domarinn CLI.

server_url.title: domarinn server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your domarinn server, e.g. https://domarinn.example.com. Leave blank to use the CLI-only skills without connecting to a server.

api_token.title: domarinn API token
api_token.description: A read-scoped API key (domarinn_...) or static token. Create one under Settings -> API keys, or set DOMARINN_TOKENS=read:<token> on the server.
